# unifi_pending_devices (Data Source)

Lists devices awaiting adoption via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only and site-independent. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List devices awaiting adoption (Official API, site-independent).
data "unifi_pending_devices" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing pending devices.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The devices awaiting adoption. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `adoption_target_site_ids` (List of String) The UUIDs of the sites the device can be adopted into.
- `features` (List of String) The device feature roles (e.g. `switching`, `accessPoint`, `gateway`).
- `firmware_updatable` (Boolean) Whether a firmware update is available for the device.
- `firmware_version` (String) The device firmware version, if known.
- `ip_address` (String) The device IP address.
- `json` (String) The full pending-device record serialized as a JSON string.
- `mac_address` (String) The device MAC address.
- `model` (String) The device model.
- `state` (String) The device state (e.g. `PENDING_ADOPTION`).
- `supported` (Boolean) Whether the device is supported by the controller.
